story.heading: Our story
story.body:
Built on Trust. Driven by Performance.

Since 2010, PT Amalia Utama has grown from an apparel supplier into a trusted corporate and institutional distribution partner, serving organizations across Indonesia with authentic sportswear and branded apparel.

Today, we support corporations, government institutions, educational organizations, sports communities, and other large institutions with complete apparel solutions, from product selection and customization, to procurement and nationwide delivery.

As an authorized B2B partner and distributor of Adidas Indonesia, we bring global brand standards and performance apparel to the corporate and institutional market. Our portfolio also includes other trusted performance and lifestyle brands, giving organizations greater flexibility to express their identity.
We believe corporate apparel is more than what people wear. It reflects how an organization presents itself, builds team identity, and connects with its people.

With a focus on authentic products, reliable execution, responsive service, and long-term relationships, we have supported more than 500 organizations and equipped over 50,000 team members.
From individual team orders to nationwide corporate programs, PT Amalia Utama delivers apparel solutions built around performance, identity, and partnership.

From sportswear to corporate identity. From products to partnerships.
